title: Brazil’s dangerous environmental licensing bill | Science
content: On 17 July, Brazil’s Congress approved Bill 2159/2021 (1), which aims to simplify the environmental licensing process in Brazil, an essential process for terrestrial and maritime economic activities. Proponents argue that the current system is excessively bureaucratic, delaying projects that are important to the country’s development (2). However, the policies in the bill represent a setback in environmental protection and social participation in decisions that affect Brazil’s rich biomes.
